defaultView.title: Default View
defaultView.description: When no filters are selected, display a summary of the most recent tracked objects per label, or display an unfiltered grid.

columns.title: Grid Columns
columns.description: Select the number of columns in the grid view.

source.title: Search Source
source.description: Choose whether to search the thumbnails or descriptions of your tracked objects.

semantic.title: Semantic Search
semantic.description: Frigate can use machine learning to search for objects based on their visual appearance or description.

reindex.title: Reindex on Startup
reindex.description: When enabled, Frigate will reindex all objects on startup. This is useful if you have made changes to your object labels or want to ensure all objects are indexed.

model.title: Model Size
model.description: Choose the model size that best fits your needs. Larger models are more accurate but use more resources.

small.title: Small
small.description: Faster, but less accurate. Good for basic searches.

large.title: Large
large.description: More accurate, but uses more resources. Best for detailed searches.
